localContext: Dayton is anchored by Wright-Patterson Air Force Base and the Air Force Research Laboratory, with a dense network of aerospace and defense suppliers, University of Dayton Research Institute materials work, and older foundry, forging and automotive supplier shops. Work runs to customer-specified aerospace requirements, ASTM and ASME methods and quality manuals. Training here needs traceable records and strong penetrant, magnetic particle and UT fundamentals under an employer written practice.
certPathwayNote: Dayton employers certify under an SNT-TC-1A written practice, and the employer signs the certificate. Aerospace and defense customers often add flow-down requirements or approvals of their own, which the employer's Level III reconciles with the program. ASNT central certification is the alternative route, and Atlantis prepares candidates for it.
